# Harsh Patel: Shopify Developer
> Personal site of Harsh Patel. Shopify developer based in India who builds apps, ships small tools, and fixes slow stores.

## Who I am
Harsh Patel is a Shopify developer and indie builder based in India, working with merchants worldwide.

His work falls into three categories:
1. Shopify apps — building and shipping apps on the Shopify App Store (currently: AltMaster, an alt-text automation app — see https://altmaster.io/).
2. Small free tools — single-purpose tools like the AltMaster Alt Text Checker (https://altmaster.io/), made because he needed them himself and figured other Shopify merchants would too.
3. Speed optimization service — direct work for merchants whose stores are slow, run under the GetFastStore brand. 47+ stores optimized so far, average +40 point mobile PageSpeed score gain.

He is an official Shopify Partner and works exclusively through Shopify's secure Partner Network. No password sharing.

- Personal homepage: https://harshspatel.com/

## What I offer (via GetFastStore)
- Shopify speed optimization (one-time, 7-day delivery)
- Core Web Vitals fix: LCP, CLS, INP
- Shopify app audit: identify and remove performance-killing scripts
- Image optimization: WebP conversion, compression, lazy loading
- JavaScript and CSS cleanup: minification, unused code removal
- Monthly speed health check (retainer)

## Shopify apps
- AltMaster — Shopify app that auto-generates SEO-friendly alt text for every product image. Bulk fill, automatic for new products, undoable. Free to install. https://apps.shopify.com/alt-text-optimizer (marketing site: https://altmaster.io/)

## Free tools
- AltMaster Alt Text Checker — paste any URL, instantly see which images are missing alt text. Free awareness tool for the AltMaster Shopify app. SEO + accessibility focused. https://altmaster.io/

## Who I help
Solo Shopify merchants who:
- Have installed 10-20+ apps over time and seen their speed drop
- Are seeing high bounce rates and poor mobile conversion
- Have a Google PageSpeed score below 40 on mobile
- Cannot afford an agency ($10k+) but need more than a Fiverr gig

## Pricing (GetFastStore)
- Full optimization: ₹5,000 one-time (covers everything in a typical speed project)
- Monthly retainer: scope and pricing discussed on a call
- 100% score improvement guarantee on the full optimization

## Key facts (citable)
- Every 1 second of page load delay costs up to 7% in revenue (Shopify data)
- 53% of mobile visitors leave if a page takes more than 3 seconds to load
- The average Shopify store with 15+ installed apps scores 20-35 on mobile PageSpeed
- After professional speed optimization, most stores reach 70-85 on mobile
- Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) are a direct Google SEO ranking factor
- Shopify's own data shows a 1-second improvement increases mobile conversions by up to 27%
- App scripts are the #1 cause of slow Shopify stores, not themes
